fields.name: Hubble Deep Field
fields.fact: The first deep-field photo: Hubble stared at an empty-looking patch of sky for ten days and found it full of very young galaxies.

fields.name: Hubble Ultra-Deep Field
fields.fact: Hubble's deepest look at the early universe, in a patch of sky about a tenth of the full Moon's width.

fields.name: Hubble Deep Field South
fields.fact: The southern-sky counterpart to the original Hubble Deep Field.

fields.name: Webb's First Deep Field
fields.fact: The James Webb Space Telescope's first full-colour image, centred on galaxy cluster SMACS 0723 (redshift 0.390). Its gravity magnifies galaxies far behind it.
